project.title: Cross-Plant Predictive Maintenance Rollout for Production Lines
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardized predictive maintenance program to reduce unplanned downtime and maintenance costs across key production assets.
deliverables: Standardized asset criticality and maintenance strategy matrix
Predictive maintenance process and escalation workflow
Sensor and data collection specification for priority equipment
Cross-functional training plan and materials for maintenance and operations staff
KPI dashboard definition for downtime, MTBF, and maintenance compliance
Pilot implementation report with lessons learned and rollout plan
constraints: Pilot must go live within 21 days with at least two production lines
No disruption to committed production volumes during installation
Use existing CMMS and data infrastructure where possible
Comply with plant safety and lockout/tagout procedures
Limited capex budget for new sensors and instrumentation
Maintenance windows restricted to scheduled off-peak shifts

risks.risk: Insufficient data quality from existing sensors to support predictive models.
risks.mitigation: Run a short data quality assessment, prioritize a subset of assets, and define minimum sensor upgrade list for the pilot.

risks.risk: Operations teams resist changes to existing maintenance routines.
risks.mitigation: Involve line supervisors early, co-design procedures, and run a limited pilot with clear benefits and quick feedback loops.

risks.risk: Installation work overruns maintenance windows and impacts production.
risks.mitigation: Create detailed installation checklists, pre-stage materials, and schedule contingency windows with production planning.

risks.risk: Budget constraints limit sensor and tooling purchases.
risks.mitigation: Rank assets by criticality, focus on high-impact equipment first, and reuse existing hardware where feasible.

risks.risk: Lack of alignment between maintenance, operations, and aftersales service on priorities.
risks.mitigation: Set up weekly cross-functional check-ins and publish a shared priority list and status board.

themes.why_relevant: Determines which machines enter the pilot and where to focus limited budget and effort.
Ensures operations, maintenance, and garage teams follow consistent procedures across sites.
Defines what data is needed, from where, and how it will be used for predictive insights.
Aligns maintenance work with production plans to avoid missed delivery commitments.
Helps staff adopt new processes, tools, and KPIs without confusion or resistance.
Links improved reliability to fewer field failures and better service outcomes.

backlog.task: Define asset criticality criteria and select pilot equipment on two production lines
definition_of_done: Criticality criteria document approved by operations and maintenance
List of pilot assets for two lines finalized and shared
Risks of including each asset briefly documented

backlog.task: Map current maintenance workflows and identify standardization gaps
definition_of_done: As-is maintenance workflow diagrams created for at least two plants
Key differences and pain points summarized
List of standardization opportunities agreed with maintenance leads

backlog.task: Design predictive maintenance process and escalation paths
definition_of_done: To-be process flow documented from alert to resolution
Escalation thresholds and roles defined for each asset class
Process validated with operations manager and garage manager

backlog.task: Specify sensor and data requirements for selected pilot assets
definition_of_done: List of required signals and sampling frequencies per asset created
Gap analysis between current and required instrumentation completed
Low-level wiring and installation notes drafted for maintenance teams

backlog.task: Align maintenance windows with production planning for pilot rollout
definition_of_done: Maintenance windows agreed for each pilot line
No conflict with confirmed customer orders for the pilot period
Shared calendar created and communicated to stakeholders

backlog.task: Develop training materials for operators, maintenance, and garage staff
definition_of_done: Role-specific training outlines created
Slide deck and quick reference guides drafted
Training plan with dates and target attendees approved

backlog.task: Define KPIs and dashboard requirements for downtime and maintenance performance
definition_of_done: List of KPIs with clear definitions and formulas agreed
Data sources for each KPI identified
Dashboard wireframe or layout documented

backlog.task: Prepare installation checklist and safety procedures for sensor deployment
definition_of_done: Step-by-step installation checklist drafted
Safety and lockout/tagout steps clearly included
Checklist reviewed by health and safety officer

backlog.task: Coordinate pilot implementation on shop floor and in garage area
definition_of_done: Implementation schedule confirmed with all teams
Daily status updates captured during installation week
Pilot go-live confirmed with no unplanned downtime incidents

backlog.task: Document pilot results, issues, and recommendations for scale-up
definition_of_done: Pilot performance data collected for agreed period
Key issues and root causes summarized
Scale-up recommendations and next steps documented

backlog.task: Validate electrical safety and integration with existing control systems
definition_of_done: Compatibility with existing control panels verified
Load and interference checks completed and documented
Sign-off from plant electrical safety representative obtained

backlog.task: Capture customer-facing impact and aftersales service feedback
definition_of_done: Aftersales and service teams interviewed on failure trends
Any change in warranty claims or service incidents noted
Summary of customer impact included in pilot report

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on pilot scope, asset selection, and success criteria.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the predictive maintenance initiative and asking for input on pilot scope.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the list of pilot assets and lines from the asset criticality matrix.
Agree on 3–5 primary KPIs to track during the pilot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Design and finalize the standardized predictive maintenance workflow.
threads_plan.trigger: Operations manager shares draft of the to-be maintenance process for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the standardized predictive maintenance process and escalation paths.
Confirm which roles are responsible for triaging and responding to alerts.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock down sensor specs, installation plan, and safety procedures.
threads_plan.trigger: Electrical engineer posts proposed sensor list and asks for feasibility feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final sensor and data collection specification for the pilot assets.
Agree on the installation schedule and safety checklist to use on site.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate pilot go-live, training, and daily status updates.
threads_plan.trigger: Week before go-live, operations manager opens coordination thread for rollout.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot go-live date and maintenance windows for all lines.
Agree on training dates and which teams must attend each session.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results, customer impact, and decide on rollout roadmap.
threads_plan.trigger: After pilot period, industrial production manager shares draft lessons learned.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Reconfirm or adjust pilot asset scope based on performance data for scale-up.
Revisit and finalize long-term ownership of alert triage and escalation.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each role posts yesterday's progress, today's plan, and blockers for the pilot.
Weekly cross-functional sync thread to review KPIs, incidents, and adjust priorities.
Pre-maintenance window checklist post to confirm readiness and responsibilities before each installation slot.
Post-go-live review thread after major milestones to capture quick wins and issues.
End-of-pilot retrospective thread to gather feedback and agree on improvements for rollout.
